aboutPreview.bio: Josué Cabrera (Mexico City, 1986). Stage artist, theatre teacher, popular dance instructor, cook, and developer. As you can probably tell, he has never been very good at sitting still, which has led him to move around and try living in all sorts of places. He was born in what was then the Federal District and, at the age of one, moved to Ciudad Neza, where he grew up. As an adult —yes, really— he moved to Tláhuac and later to the Narvarte neighborhood in present-day Mexico City. Some time later, he headed to Yucatán to sample the sweetness of life in Mérida and, when it turned out not to be quite so sweet, moved on to Chelem, a small coastal community in Progreso. As the COVID-19 pandemic was nearing its end, a stroke of luck brought him to Puerto Morelos, Quintana Roo, where he somehow managed to move three times within the same charming little town in just one year. He is currently planning his next move: Argentina.
